description: Source code for Android media session client integration in the Cobalt project, handling media session state changes, actions, and callbacks via JNI.

methods.name: MediaSessionActionsToPlaybackStateActions
methods.description: Converts a boolean array of actions into a bitset for Android playback state.

methods.name: CobaltExtensionPlaybackStateToPlaybackState
methods.description: Maps internal media session playback states to Android playback states.

methods.name: PlaybackStateActionToMediaSessionAction
methods.description: Converts Android playback action bitset into internal media session action enum.

methods.name: NativeInvokeAction
methods.description: Handles invocation of media session actions from Java.

methods.name: UpdateActiveSessionPlatformPlaybackState
methods.description: Updates the platform playback state callback.

methods.name: OnMediaSessionStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in media session state and updates Java UI.

methods.name: RegisterMediaSessionCallbacks
methods.description: Registers callbacks for media session actions and state updates.

methods.name: DestroyMediaSessionClientCallback
methods.description: Clears callbacks and deactivates media session.
